Zoe (Head of Marketing): Heads up 4: KPI pulse check. Launch benchmark post drove a ton of traffic but our demo conversion dipped. Need quick triage on routing + dashboard signals: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/kpi-pulse :mag:
Becca (Growth): noticed the same. demo conversion for utm_campaign=benchmark_hub is 1.7% vs baseline 2.6%.
Omar (Analytics): running breakdown now. top-line: sessions +35%, signups +20%, demo_bookings flat. pulling sample export.
Carlos (Events): We pushed the partner webinar CTA on the benchmark hub last Tuesday as a test, might be skewing quality.
Omar (Analytics): sample:
```
2026-03-25,benchmark_hub,organic,300,8,5
2026-03-25,benchmark_hub,paid,500,13,6
2026-03-26,benchmark_hub,partners,120,2,0
```
Omar (Analytics): partners segment has near-zero demo conversions here. Further, last-click gives partners low MQL count but multi-touch shows partners influence earlier in the funnel.
Zoe (Head of Marketing): We need a short-term fix and a longer-term attribution policy. Short-term: set partner-traffic to mirror into inbound so we can measure end-to-end. Long-term: formalize attribution model in the KPI doc.
lead-router-bot: rule-report: utm_source=partners -> pipeline:partner_ops (created 2026-02-10)
Mika Ops: I can add 'mirror_to: inbound' tag for 5 days so analytics can see parity without changing partner SLAs.
Becca (Growth): Also can we surface a 'quality by CTA' tile on the weekly dashboard? Many of these experiments change CTAs and we need to attribute quality to the creative.
Omar (Analytics): good idea. I'll add a "CTA quality" tile and add a breakdown by form type (short vs long). ETA 5 hours.
Carlos (Events): I'll pause the partner-only banner on the hub for 48h.
Zoe (Head of Marketing): Action list: Mika (mirror tag 5d), Omar (CTA quality tile + exports), Carlos (pause banner), Becca (note in playbook about CTA impacts). Weekly KPI review Friday we present findings.
Mika Ops: mirror tag scheduled starting 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z for 5 days (created by Mika Ops).
Becca (Growth): I'll add a short note in the playbook: "When running partner co-promos, always mirror leads to inbound and mark CTA type."
Omar (Analytics): added CTA quality tile: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/widgets/cta-quality  saved views: form_short vs form_long. note: sample sizes in partner cohort small.
Zoe (Head of Marketing): Thanks. Also let's make sure the executive KPI doc clarifies that the headline demo conversion uses last-click. We don't want the board to misinterpret the dip.
Omar (Analytics): updated. wrote: "Executive KPIs = last-click by default; see multi-touch widgets for partner influence."
Zoe (Head of Marketing): Solid. We'll check results Friday morning. If demo conversion doesn't recover, we'll revert the CTA and revisit targeting.
